test_title: PYST 05: SSC JE CE - General Awareness (Held on 06 Jun 2024 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question:
Which of the following are the functions of the National Commission for Scheduled Castes?

1) Providing Constitutional protection to Scheduled Castes

2) Investigating any case that violates the interests of Scheduled Castes

3) Submitting a report to the Prime Minister related to the protection of Scheduled Castes

4) Presenting to the President, annually and at such other times as the Commission may deem fit, reports upon the working of those safeguards
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only 1, 2 and 4**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The National Commission for Scheduled Castes (NCSC) is an important body in India dedicated to the protection and welfare of Scheduled Castes (SCs). Let's analyze each function listed in the question to determine which are the correct responsibilities of the NCSC.
 
• **Providing Constitutional protection to Scheduled Castes** - This statement is correct. The NCSC is tasked with monitoring and investigating how the constitutional safeguards for SCs are implemented and adhered to. However, it does not directly provide these protections itself; its role is more supervisory and advisory.
 
• **Investigating any case that violates the interests of Scheduled Castes** - This is a correct function of the NCSC. According to Article 338 of the Indian Constitution, the commission has the power to investigate and monitor matters relating to the safeguards provided for SCs and to inquire into specific complaints regarding the deprivation of rights and safeguards of these communities.
 
• **Submitting a report to the Prime Minister related to the protection of Scheduled Castes** - This statement is incorrect. The NCSC submits its report to the President, not the Prime Minister. The commission presents reports on how the safeguards for SCs are being carried out, among other details.
 
• **Presenting to the President, annually and at such other times as the Commission may deem fit, reports upon the working of those safeguards** - This statement is correct. The NCSC is authorized to present annual reports to the President on the implementation of constitutional and other legal safeguards for SCs. The President then places these reports before each House of Parliament along with a memorandum explaining the action taken on the recommendations of the Commission.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The NCSC was established under **Article 338** of the Constitution of India.
 
• The Commission consists of a Chairperson, a Vice-Chairperson, and three other Members appointed by the President of India.
 
• The NCSC is tasked with investigating and monitoring all matters relating to the constitutional and legal safeguards provided for the Scheduled Castes and evaluating the working of such safeguards.
 
• The Commission also participates and advises on the planning process of socio-economic development of the Scheduled Castes and evaluates the progress of their development under the Union and any State.
 
• It has the authority to inquire into specific complaints with respect to the deprivation of rights and safeguards of the Scheduled Castes.
